system.description:
You bring your charm to bear on a single person until your manner becomes hypnotically, irresistibly magnetic.

Make a Social Challenge against the target (retest Leadership). On a success they are favorably disposed toward you and will not insult or attack you for the rest of the scene or hour: a neutral subject wants to aid you as a friend, and a hostile subject is rendered neutral. If you take a hostile action against the subject the Entrancement breaks immediately and cannot be used on them again that scene.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
